seasons.name: Summer

weather.description: Hot, dry and bright. The sun is sharp by nine in the morning, the ground cracks, and hot winds blow across the fields in the afternoon. Nights remain warm. Dust rises from the lanes.
weather.teluguDescription: ఎండలు ఎక్కువగా ఉంటాయి. ఉదయం తొమ్మిదికే ఎండ చురుక్కుమంటుంది. నేల నెర్రెలు విచ్చుతుంది. మధ్యాహ్నం వేడి గాలులు వీస్తాయి. సందుల్లో దుమ్ము లేస్తుంది.

farmWork.task: Harvest of summer groundnut and sesame
Deep ploughing of dry fields to bury weeds and open the soil
Clearing silt from the cheruvu bed and strengthening the bund
Spreading farmyard manure before the rains
Repairing ploughs, yokes and pump motors

characterActivities.activity: Sits in banyan shade at noon and tells old summer stories; walks to the cheruvu at dawn before the heat
Dries mango slices for pickles on the roof; makes vadiyalu and appadalu
Runs the mango pickle season: cutting, salting, sun-curing, jarring
Reports water levels in wells and advises farmers on summer crops
Repairs pumps that fail in the heat
Treats heatstroke, dehydration and stomach upsets
Holidays begin; he reads in the library and walks to the cheruvu in the evening
Climbs the neem for flowers and plays under the banyan
Hunts for mango and tamarind with friends
Digs clay from the shrinking cheruvu edge for pots
Sells watermelons, cucumbers and curd at the weekly market
Stocks buttermilk, lemons and cold drinks

locationChanges.pandu-house: Mangoes and tamarind dry on the roof; the courtyard is washed twice a day; mats are moved to the roof at night
locationChanges.school: Closed for the summer holiday; the ground is silent except for a stray dog; teachers return for admissions in June
locationChanges.library: Becomes a cool refuge; the ceiling fan is the main attraction and the reading room is full by noon
locationChanges.temple: Priest changes ritual hours to dawn and dusk; chandanam (sandal paste) is offered to cool the deity; sherbets given as prasadam
locationChanges.banyan-tree: Busiest place in the village; the stone platform stays shaded and cool; card games and gossip last until dusk
locationChanges.cheruvu: Shrinks and shows cracked edges; cattle crowd the remaining water; fish concentrate near the centre; lotus pads wilt
locationChanges.fields: Mostly brown and bare; only irrigated plots show green; dust devils cross the empty plots

learningThemes: Heat, shade and water scarcity words

seasons.name: Monsoon

weather.description: Heavy rain from clouds that gather by noon. Roads turn to mud, frogs sing all night, the cheruvu fills and overflows its sluice, and humidity makes everything damp. Occasional cyclone rains in October.
weather.teluguDescription: మధ్యాహ్నానికి మబ్బులు కమ్ముకుని జోరుగా వర్షం కురుస్తుంది. బాటలు బురదగా మారతాయి. రాత్రంతా కప్పలు అరుస్తాయి. చెరువు నిండి అలుగు పారుతుంది. అంతా తడిగా ఉంటుంది.

farmWork.task: Nursery beds for paddy seedlings
Puddling and levelling flooded fields
Transplanting paddy seedlings by hand
First weeding and fertiliser top-dressing
Sowing groundnut and pulses on higher plots
Checking bunds for breaches

characterActivities.activity: Walks the bunds before dawn and judges the water depth with his shin
Leads the transplanting women and gives short instructions in rhythm
Sings transplanting songs with the working women
Sows groundnut on the uplands
Measures rainfall, advises on seed varieties and fertiliser
Treats fevers, dengue suspects and water-borne illness; runs a field fever round after rain
Gives injections and distributes chlorine tablets
College resumes; he travels by bus in the rain and watches transplanting from the road
School term begins; catches paper boats in puddles
Stops pottery because clay won't dry; shapes Ganesha idols indoors
Repairs lines damaged by storms; works through night faults
Drives the bus through flooded stretches with caution

locationChanges.pandu-house: Roof leaks are patched with plastic; clothes hang indoors; the courtyard becomes slippery with moss; the smell of wet earth is constant
locationChanges.school: Reopens in June with new uniforms; the ground floods in a corner; children hold their sandals and splash through
locationChanges.library: Humid; the librarian airs books on sunny days; newspapers get damp; quiet corners fill with children sheltering
locationChanges.temple: Floors are slippery; lamps struggle in the wind; Vinayaka Chavithi and Dasara bring crowds despite the rain
locationChanges.banyan-tree: Shelter during showers; the tea stall moves under a tarpaulin; tree roots drip steadily
locationChanges.cheruvu: Fills to the brim, overflows the sluice, lotus pads open wide; children are forbidden to swim; frogs and egrets crowd the banks
locationChanges.fields: Turn to flooded mirrors; transplanted rows form green lines; egrets follow the plough

learningThemes: Action sequences with ముందు, తర్వాత, చివరికి

weather.description: Cool mornings with mist over the fields and cheruvu, light fog until eight, clear sunny afternoons, and cold nights. People wear shawls and light a fire at the banyan in the evening.
weather.teluguDescription: ఉదయాలు చల్లగా ఉంటాయి. పొలాలపై, చెరువుపై మంచు కమ్ముతుంది. ఎనిమిది వరకు పొగమంచు. మధ్యాహ్నం ఎండగా ఉంటుంది. రాత్రులు చలి. జనం శాలువాలు కప్పుకుంటారు.

farmWork.task: Harvest of paddy with sickles and threshing on the threshing floor
Winnowing grain in the breeze
Storing grain in gunny sacks and bins
Sowing pulses, chillies and vegetables in the residual moisture
Selling crop at the mandal market
Preparing straw stacks for cattle fodder

characterActivities.activity: Supervises harvest and threshing; checks the weighing at the mandal
Leads the women reaping in rows; cooks for the working crew
Sells grain; counts sacks twice
Coordinates with the mandal for procurement centres
Brings cattle for threshing; checks their health
Sits by the threshing floor and counts bundles; tells harvest memories
Prepares sankranti foods; stores new rice
Sells pots for pongal; stacks cheruvu clay for the next year
Exam season; studies in the library; helps on the farm at weekends
Annual exams; draws muggulu for Sankranti
Leads Kartika lamp lighting and Sankranti women's circle

locationChanges.pandu-house: Courtyard filled with sacks of new grain; early morning fires warm the kitchen; shawls hang on the verandah
locationChanges.school: Morning assembly in shawls; exams in February; the ground is cold and wet with dew until nine
locationChanges.library: Exam students crowd in; warm sunlight hits the reading tables in the afternoon; electric heater rarely used
locationChanges.temple: Kartika lamps cover every step; Mukkoti Ekadasi and Sankranti bring crowds before dawn
locationChanges.banyan-tree: A small campfire burns in the evening; men wrap in shawls and talk markets and crop prices
locationChanges.cheruvu: Mist rises in the early morning; water is clear and cold; lamps are floated on Kartika Pournami; migratory birds arrive
locationChanges.fields: Golden paddy ready for harvest; rows of reapers; threshing floors dotted with piles of grain and straw; chilli beds appear after

weather.description: A brief mild season between winter and summer. New leaves on the neem and mango, koel calls begin, mango blossoms scent the lanes, evenings become pleasant, and the nights are warm but not hot.
weather.teluguDescription: చలికాలం, వేసవికాలం మధ్య ఉండే తక్కువ రోజుల ఋతువు. వేప, మామిడి చెట్లు చిగురిస్తాయి. కోయిల కూతలు మొదలవుతాయి. మామిడి పూత వాసన సందులన్నిటా వ్యాపిస్తుంది. సాయంత్రాలు హాయిగా ఉంటాయి.

farmWork.task: Final harvest of late-season crops and vegetables
Mango orchard care: spraying and propping flowering branches
Preparing fields for summer by deep ploughing
Collecting neem flowers and tender leaves for festival use
Selling vegetables and flowers at the market

characterActivities.activity: Prepares the panchangam reading for Ugadi
Gathers neem flowers, tamarind, and raw mango for ugadi pachadi
Cleans the house with turmeric water and ties mango torana
Sits on the stone bench and recites spring verses to children
Final exam preparation; hears koels at dawn
Collects fallen mango blossoms and draws them
Climbs trees for raw mangoes and gets scolded
Walks to the cheruvu early to listen to birds
Surveys mango orchards and advises on flowering
Arranges a small spring poetry reading

locationChanges.pandu-house: Mango torana at the door; neem tree turns bright green; jasmine on the verandah; courtyard smells of turmeric and fresh dung wash
locationChanges.school: Annual day rehearsals; cultural programmes in the afternoon; the neem sheds old leaves and grows new ones
locationChanges.library: Spring poetry reading day; a vase of flowers appears on the librarian's desk; fewer students as exams begin
locationChanges.temple: Ugadi panchanga sravanam; Rama Navami preparations; kalyanam pandal being built
locationChanges.banyan-tree: New red leaves emerge; birds nest; the platform is swept after the winter fire
locationChanges.cheruvu: Water slowly drops; lotus buds appear; swallows skim the surface; fishing begins on the far bank
locationChanges.fields: Late vegetable patches in flower; wheat-coloured stubble; mango orchards at the edge hum with bees
